messages.text: aaj full motivation mill gya hai
to tumbhi time btado jisse mai uss time online aajau
fir jake avika ke marks dekh ke aagye
but kritika bol rahi thi ki fail hai vo
but mujhe nahi lag raha hai ki uske 50 + honge
aur joby sir avika bta rahe hai
to mujhe purrre raste gussa tha ki mujhse nahi ho paaya shyad fir
mai be I am a loser
to ghar aake didi se sabb batay to usne motivate kiya hai
bataye to sab subject ka hai
Dekhna hai ki tumse kon competition me age hai
